question: Bharatiya Nagarik suraksha Samhita(BNSS) ensures access to FIR through which portal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CCTNS**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Crime and Criminal Tracking Network and Systems (CCTNS)** is a comprehensive and integrated system for effective policing through e-Governance.
 
• It was launched by the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA), Government of India, in 2009 as part of the national e-governance initiative.
 
• CCTNS facilitates a nationwide networked infrastructure for tracking crime and criminals in real-time, ensuring seamless sharing of information between police stations and higher police authorities.
 
• The system also enables citizens to access police services such as lodging FIRs, tracking case status, and obtaining verification certificates online.
 
• As of now, most states and union territories in India use the CCTNS platform to provide services like digital filing of FIRs, improving transparency and efficiency in policing activities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Crime Portal**

 
 
• It is not a specific portal but often refers to platforms like the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) website.
 
• The NCRB is responsible for collecting and analyzing crime data as mandated by the Ministry of Home Affairs but does not directly allow citizens to lodge FIRs.
 
 
 
• **BHAVISHYA**
 
 
• BHAVISHYA is an online Pension Sanction and Payment Tracking System launched by the Government of India.
 
• It is designed to cater to retiring employees for tracking their pension process, ensuring transparency and timely disbursal.
 
• This portal is unrelated to crime or police services.
 
 
 
• **DIGI-FIR**
 
 
• DIGI-FIR is a concept introduced in some states like Madhya Pradesh to allow citizens to lodge FIRs online.
 
• While it serves a similar purpose, it is not implemented nationwide or as comprehensively as CCTNS.
 
 
 
• **Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Samhita (BNSS)**
 
 
• The BNSS is a proposed draft legislation aimed at replacing the existing Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC) to modernize and streamline the criminal justice system in India.
 
• One of its key features is enabling citizens to access FIRs and other police services online, which aligns with the goals of CCTNS.
